title: Compound Word Puzzles

overview.description: Compound word puzzle cards. Likely format: two-piece interlocking puzzle cards — one half shows word 1 + image, other half shows word 2 + image. When matched correctly, the puzzle pieces interlock and the compound word is formed. Self-correcting: only the correct halves fit together. Third compound word resource from Aless (after I Have Who Has chain game + Snowball Fight movement game). Three different game mechanics for the same skill.

puzzleSelfCorrection.description: Interlocking puzzle pieces only fit when the match is correct. Same self-correcting principle as Montessori nomenclature cards — the material itself provides the error check.
puzzleSelfCorrection.value: Independent learning. No teacher needed to verify matches.

gaps.name: two-piece-puzzle-cards
gaps.description: Interlocking puzzle card pairs: each pair forms a match (compound word, math equation = answer, Spanish word = English word). Cut from cardstock, self-correcting through unique interlock shapes. Generatable for any matching skill.

notes: Link likely expired. Third compound word format: chain game (auditory/social) + snowball fight (kinesthetic/movement) + puzzles (tactile/self-correcting). Three game mechanics, one skill. This is Aless showing what Carolyng described when she talked about visual/kinesthetic/auditory options — multiple pathways to the same learning.
